messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT  gateway-eu-west high timeout/5xx spike (5m window)
incident-bot: alert_id=GATEWAY_TIMEOUTS_EU severity=page channel=eng-oncall target=oncall

maya: acked. seeing a big uptick in 504/502 from gateway -> faststream-recs. spike started ~14:10 UTC.
liam: I'm on logs and tracing. initial look shows request queues building on proxy connections to faststream and a lot of 'upstream connection reset' errors. no prod deploys in last 45m.
nora: assigning incident INC-3278 and marking priority P1. creating ticket: https://phabricator.redwood/t/INC-3278
sara: tagging customer-impact and support loop. will prepare short comms if we need to notify customers.

maya: mitigation idea: flip gateway to degrade_recs and route a fraction of traffic (~30%) to eu-west-2 which is healthy. can we do weighted routing?
liam: yes, canary routing via edge rules. running: ```edgectl route add-weight --service gateway --region eu-west-2 --weight 30```
liam: also bump gateway pod grace to avoid cold starts: ```kubectl scale deploy gateway -n prod --replicas=8``` (was 4).

monitoring-bot: autoscaler triggered new nodes for prod -> expected capacity in ~55s.

maya: also temporarily enabling fast-fail circuit-breaker for faststream in gateway config to prevent long tail waits:
```yaml
circuit_breakers:
  faststream:
    max_consecutive_errors: 5
    timeout_ms: 800
    retry_after_ms: 2000
```

liam: after applying circuit-breaker and routing weight, 5xx rate dropped from 3.1% -> 1.0% in 3 minutes. connection-reset errors still visible but reduced.
nora: vendor faststream on-call notified via support channel; they replied they are experiencing increased GC pauses and are rolling a patch. ETA ~30m.
sara: adding customer impact note: personalization requests may return fallback content or cached recs for ~20% of EU sessions during spike window.

maya: to reduce alert noise while we stabilize, proposing to silence the existing alert for 2h: ```/alertmanager silence add --match 'alertname=GATEWAY_TIMEOUTS_EU' --duration=2h --comment='stabilization after vendor flapping'```

liam: long-term tune suggestions, based on today's behavior:
- don't fire raw 5xx ratio alerts on small traffic shreds; require both ratio and absolute count
- add provider-specific alerts (faststream_error_rate) so vendor ops get pages and we don't page the whole infra team
- monitor proxy connection pool saturation and expose "conn_pool_in_use" metric to alert on queueing early
- add a dashboard panel for region-to-provider latencies and GC/events on provider side (if vendor exports metrics)

monitoring-bot: note: recent change (#421) increased upstream connect timeout from 500ms -> 1500ms in config. might have increased concurrent in-flight requests to provider during their GC window.

maya: that config change could be the culprit. action item: rollback or feature-flag adaptive timeouts.
nora: creating follow-up tasks linked to INC-3278: T-802 (rollback timeout change), T-803 (add conn_pool metric + dashboard), T-804 (provider-specific page rule), T-805 (runbook update).
sara: documented timeline and mitigation steps in INC-3278 ticket. scheduling postmortem 10:00 UTC tomorrow. owner = nora.

liam: suggested alert rule rewrite (staging test first): only page if absolute 5xx count > 100 AND 5xx_ratio > 0.01 for 5m. sustained high severity if 5xx_ratio >= 0.02 for 15m. sample PromQL:```yaml
- alert: GatewayElevated5xx
  expr: |
    (
      sum(increase(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (region) > 100
    )
    and
    (
      sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (region)
      / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"gateway\"}[5m])) by (region) > 0.01
    )
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

maya: also add a "provider-only" alert: faststream_error_rate > 1% for 3m that pages vendor owners. reduces internal noise.

nora: I'll validate these rules in staging for 2 hours then promote to prod if stable. leaving a note: do not silence provider-only alerts in future unless vendor confirms mitigation.

sara: handing off rotating oncall to @nora for night shift. summary for handoff:
- mitigations in place: weighted routing to eu-west-2, circuit-breaker enabled, scaled gateway to 8 replicas
- vendor rolling fix for GC pauses (ETA ~30m)
- silenced global alert for 2h to reduce noise
- follow-ups: T-802..T-805

nora: got it. I'll keep an eye on dashboard 'Gateway Regional Overview' and watch for connection_pool_saturation > 0.7. re-enable alerts when vendor confirms or metrics stable for 30m.

maya: logging final note: incident marked mitigated at 14:47 UTC. moving to post-incident review.
sara: postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-3278.md (PR created).

nora: starting staging validation for new alert shapes now. will report back before midnight UTC.```
